name: fast-quick-open
description: A fast, persistent file picker for large workspaces, powered by fd and fzf

items.description: Directory to index. Relative paths start from each workspace folder.

fastQuickOpen.roots.markdownDescription: Directories covered by the normal file index. Relative paths resolve from each workspace folder, so the default `.` means the whole workspace. A nested root is indexed separately without duplicating its files in the parent. [Path variables](https://github.com/goodov/fast-quick-open#path-variables) are supported; use `#fastQuickOpen.exclude#` and `#fastQuickOpen.include#` to narrow the index.

fastQuickOpen.include.markdownDescription: Bring selected directories back into the normal index after they were hidden by `#fastQuickOpen.exclude#`, `#files.exclude#`, or `#search.exclude#`. Map a path to `true` to include it. Relative paths start from each `#fastQuickOpen.roots#` entry. See [include and exclude](https://github.com/goodov/fast-quick-open#include-and-exclude).

additionalProperties.description: Turn this include path on or off.

fastQuickOpen.exclude.markdownDescription: Extra [glob patterns](https://aka.ms/vscode-glob-patterns) to leave out of the normal index. This is applied in addition to `#files.exclude#` and `#search.exclude#` when `#fastQuickOpen.useSearchExclude#` is on. Conditional `files.exclude` entries with `when` are ignored. Use `#fastQuickOpen.include#` to restore selected subdirectories. On-demand indexes have their own excludes. See [include and exclude](https://github.com/goodov/fast-quick-open#include-and-exclude).

additionalProperties.description: Turn this exclude pattern on or off.

fastQuickOpen.useSearchExclude.markdownDescription: Reuse the enabled `true` entries from `#files.exclude#` and `#search.exclude#`. This keeps files that VS Code already hides out of Fast Quick Open as well. Conditional `files.exclude` entries with `when` are ignored. See also `#fastQuickOpen.exclude#`.

fastQuickOpen.useWatcherExclude.markdownDescription: Ignore `#files.watcherExclude#` paths when watching for created or deleted files. Turn this off if watcher-excluded paths should trigger a Fast Quick Open refresh.

fastQuickOpen.reloadDebounceSeconds.markdownDescription: How many quiet seconds to wait before rebuilding the index after files are created or deleted while the picker is closed. Set to `0` to wait until the picker is opened. If the picker is already open, it refreshes immediately.

fastQuickOpen.fdHidden.markdownDescription: Include hidden files and directories such as `.github`. See also `#fastQuickOpen.fdNoIgnore#` and `#fastQuickOpen.fdFlags#`.

fastQuickOpen.fdNoIgnore.markdownDescription: Do not let `.gitignore` and other ignore files hide paths from the index. Fast Quick Open's own exclude settings still apply. See also `#fastQuickOpen.fdHidden#` and `#fastQuickOpen.fdFlags#`.

fastQuickOpen.fdPattern.markdownDescription: The [fd search pattern](https://github.com/sharkdp/fd#pattern) used while building the index. The default `.` matches everything. It is a regular expression unless you add `--glob` through `#fastQuickOpen.fdFlags#`.

fastQuickOpen.fdFlags.markdownDescription: Extra arguments for fd, the tool that builds the file list. For example, `["--max-depth", 4]` limits traversal depth. [Path variables](https://github.com/goodov/fast-quick-open#path-variables) are expanded. See also `#fastQuickOpen.fdPattern#` and `#fastQuickOpen.fzfFlags#`.

fastQuickOpen.fzfFlags.markdownDescription: Extra arguments for fzf, the tool that ranks your query. For example, `["--tiebreak=end"]` changes tie-breaking. [Path variables](https://github.com/goodov/fast-quick-open#path-variables) are expanded. See also `#fastQuickOpen.fdFlags#`.

fastQuickOpen.maxItems.markdownDescription: Maximum number of matching files shown at once. Allowed range: 1–100. An on-demand scope can choose its own limit.

items.description: A prefill template. May mix literal text with variables.

fastQuickOpen.prefill.markdownDescription: Start the picker with useful text, such as the selected path or active file. Templates are tried in order and the first non-empty one wins. For example, `["${selectedFilePath}", "${relativeFile}"]`. A keybinding can override this with `"args": { "prefill": [...] }`. See [prefill variables](https://github.com/goodov/fast-quick-open#prefill-variables).

fastQuickOpen.lowercaseQuery.markdownDescription: Make searches case-insensitive by lowercasing the query before `#fastQuickOpen.queryReplace#`. Turn this off to use fzf [smart-case](https://github.com/junegunn/fzf#search-syntax): lowercase queries stay case-insensitive, but typing an uppercase letter makes the query case-sensitive.

fastQuickOpen.queryReplace.markdownDescription: Rewrite typed queries with regular expressions before matching. Useful for stripping copied path prefixes, expanding shortcuts, or mapping repository-specific paths. Rules run in order after `#fastQuickOpen.lowercaseQuery#`. The first matching rule group wins; plain rules still run. Invalid rules are skipped and reported. See [query rewrite rules](https://github.com/goodov/fast-quick-open#query-rewrite-rules).

find.markdownDescription: JavaScript regular expression to find in the query.

replace.markdownDescription: Text to replace the match with. Supports captured groups such as `$1`, `$<name>`, and the full match `$&`.

flags.markdownDescription: JavaScript regular-expression flags. Omit this for the first match; use `g` to replace every match.

oneOf.markdownDescription: A group of rules. The first matching group runs in full; later groups are skipped. Plain rules outside groups still run.

find.markdownDescription: Regular expression to find. On the first rule, a match also selects this group.

flags.markdownDescription: JavaScript regular-expression flags. Use `g` to replace every match.

fastQuickOpen.onDemand.markdownDescription: Create extra search areas with short prefixes, such as `out`, `deps`, or `other_repo`. Their indexes are built the first time you use the prefix, which keeps less-used trees out of the normal index. Each scope has separate roots and filters; omitted search options use the top-level settings. See [on-demand scopes](https://github.com/goodov/fast-quick-open#on-demand-scopes).

items.description: Directory to index for this scope.

roots.markdownDescription: Directories searched by this scope. If omitted, the scope key itself is used as a directory under each workspace folder. Supports the same [path variables](https://github.com/goodov/fast-quick-open#path-variables) as `#fastQuickOpen.roots#`, including `${workspaceFolderList}`.

include.markdownDescription: Directories to bring back after an exclude hides them in this scope. This list is not inherited from `#fastQuickOpen.include#`.

items.description: Directory to include in this scope.

exclude.markdownDescription: [Glob patterns](https://aka.ms/vscode-glob-patterns) to leave out of this scope. This list is not inherited from `#fastQuickOpen.exclude#`.

items.description: Glob pattern to exclude from this scope.

fdHidden.markdownDescription: Choose whether this scope includes hidden files. Falls back to `#fastQuickOpen.fdHidden#` when omitted.

fdNoIgnore.markdownDescription: Choose whether this scope should disregard `.gitignore` and similar ignore files. Falls back to `#fastQuickOpen.fdNoIgnore#` when omitted.

fdPattern.markdownDescription: Fd pattern used to build this scope. Falls back to `#fastQuickOpen.fdPattern#` when omitted.

fdFlags.markdownDescription: Extra fd arguments for this scope. Falls back to `#fastQuickOpen.fdFlags#` when omitted and expands [path variables](https://github.com/goodov/fast-quick-open#path-variables).

fzfFlags.markdownDescription: Extra fzf arguments for this scope. Falls back to `#fastQuickOpen.fzfFlags#` when omitted and expands [path variables](https://github.com/goodov/fast-quick-open#path-variables).

keepKeyInQuery.description: Keep the scope prefix in the fzf query instead of removing it. Usually leave this off.

maxItems.markdownDescription: Maximum results shown for this scope (1–100). Falls back to `#fastQuickOpen.maxItems#` when omitted.

useSearchExclude.markdownDescription: Choose whether this scope uses `#files.exclude#` and `#search.exclude#`. Falls back to `#fastQuickOpen.useSearchExclude#` when omitted.

lifecycle.description: Use `destroy` to release this index when the picker closes, or `active` to keep it ready for the next search.

scripts.compile: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: pnpm run compile-tests && pnpm run compile && pnpm run lint
